profile.headline: Software Engineer Team Lead at Bloomberg LP

positions.title: Business Technology Analyst
positions.description:
As a business technology analyst, I worked with a team to deliver monthly releases and new service console functionality into a Salesforce production environment.We utilized particular aspects of Agile development including user stories, story points, grooming sessions and sizing methods (planning poker). I was evolved with the development of user stories, sizing and grooming sessions, development testing, deployment, version control management and automated deployment. I utilized tools such as Git, SourceTree, Jenkins and Ant. 

During development I created various Apex classes, including custom controllers and triggers. I also created custom Visualforce pages and refactored Visualforce pages with advanced styling and JavaScript implementations

positions.title: Pro-Bono Consultant
positions.description: During the Ivey Community Consulting Project (CCP), me and a team of 3 other students provided consulting services for a pro bono client. With the assistance of Accenture mentors, this 3 month engagement tested and displayed my skills in client relations, analysis, data gathering and presentation. We successfully went through the process of formally defining and identifying our clients issues, into preforming primary and secondary research to identify trends and gain key insights. With this analysis we crafted a three tiered recommendation for the client and developed comprehensive slide decks for them to utilize during implementation.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked with health physic lab technicians to develop internal lab applications.Projects included an application which allowed technicians to imported ASCII files from detectors. Information from files was segmented then inserted into a Microsoft Access database with a variety of other features, saving technicians over 30 minutes per day in processing time. Additionally assisted in the process of moving from segmented Access databases, to a MySQL database and building another simple application, allowing users to perform queries on the MySQL database for daily collection. Created an excel model for processing Gamma Spectroscopy files from MCNPX. Worked with VB.Net, Excel, Access, VBA, and SQL.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed systems to improve the work flow of lab technicians. Incorporated software development processes to ensure that deliverables were meet to user requirements and working software which created value was developed

educations.schoolName: Ivey Business School at Western University

honors.title: Lynn Fordham Awards in Science and Engineering
honors.description: Awarded annually to students in Science or Engineering Science who demonstrate financial need, academic excellence (full course load and minimum 75% average) and possess leadership qualities. One award will be given to a student entering first year, one to a student entering second year, one to a student entering third year and one to a student entering fourth year. This award may continue until graduation; however, the student must reapply each year and demonstrate financial need. Application forms are available at the Office of the Registrar and must be submitted not later than October 31. A statement outlining leadership qualities must be attached. Established by J. Lynn Fordham (BSc'46) through Foundation Western.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted full time Scout's Canada program leaders with the implementation of large seasonal events.

projects.title: PostR
projects.description: • Developed PostR, a web application with the ability to automatically add and remove ads to Kijiji using an Amazon EC2 instance and JavaScript for back-end development and PHP with JavaScript for front-end webpages, allowing users to automatically retain posts on a Kijiji front page.

organizations.name: Ivey Technology Club
organizations.description: As VP communications of the Ivey Technology Club I aim to crafted communications which combined information on the worlds of business and technology, exposing Ivey students to the opportunities which are available to them in today’s technology firms.
